svg.aria-label: CPU temperature, two days at 24-minute steps — Line diagram
svg.style: background: rgb(236, 239, 244); font-family: Inter, system-ui, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.desc: Line chart of 2 series, CPU package and Apple sensor, over 120 points, from Nov 20 06:00 to Nov 22 05:36; values range from 56 to 99.1.
svg.text: CPU temperature, two days at 24-minute steps
